headline: As of 2026-10-21: 17,343,465 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 45 of 50 states, D+15.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 17,343,465 early/mail ballots cast so far across 45 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+15.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,854,319), Florida (1,671,741), Texas (1,667,443).
